principle: one shared typed language; existing libraries provide implementations; semantic references hydrate only when rights and evidence gates permit

namespaces.T173:001..173: stable Raphael geometry research roles; a role is not a distinct-solid proof
namespaces.T173:174: reserved null sentinel; never an object or payload
namespaces.T3/<Grex>/<digits>: navigation/trie address; not geometry identity or unique key
namespaces.cgx://: prospective native identity, only when separately admitted
namespaces.rel:: typed relation; requires source and evidential qualifier for a supported assertion
namespaces.op:: pure planned operator; not permission to execute

semantic_trit.note: Each classification separately requires provenance, scope, confidence, time; access denial is not semantic 0; contradictory evidence requires an explicit conflict state outside the trit

transport_trit.representation: six fixed-width trits per byte for an exact simple transport demo
transport_trit.note: semantic trits and transport trits are disjoint types; six trits per byte are NOT compression

triad.status: proposed recursive composition, not a demonstrated fundamental physical law

byte_codec_invariants: roundtrip equals exact original byte sequence
no semantic inference from transport digits
release_gates: native adapter typed and roundtrip verified
